protocol.prefix: first K hours of each subject's official TRAINING file

prefix_modes.opening: first K h of the training file (the prefix-length and step-budget axes always use this)
prefix_modes.recent: last K h of the training file that clear the embargo, i.e. ending exactly one embargo before the first scored window
prefix_modes.note: the contrast holds subjects, evaluation windows, adapter, step budget and prefix LENGTH fixed; only the prefix's distance from the scored windows changes

protocol.embargo: max(configured, history + max horizon + one period)
protocol.evaluation: official TEST windows only -- disjoint from the population model's fit and val rows
protocol.pairing: before and after are scored on identical windows
